Is there a warranty or guarantee if something goes wrong?
Yes — we offer a 90-day manufacturer’s warranty on items bought directly from One Fast Cat.
If your wheel, cat tree, scratching post, or cat bed arrives with broken/defective parts, or parts break during assembly, we’ll send replacement parts free of charge up to 90 days from purchase. You don’t need to return the item for that.
Items bought through third-party sellers may have different warranty terms.
